name: Ryakudatsu Kinbaku no Yakata Kanketsu Hen
original_name: 略奪 緊縛の館 完結編
source:
Deep nested inside of a forest, there's a western-styled mansion. The young man who recently became its owner, lives there together with a beautiful girl. Even though they aren't bloodrelated, they neatly co-habitate as though they were siblings. However, before long, they have already become infatuated with one another.

The young man had been staying true to the will of his deceased father who told him on his deathbed: "Track down the whereabouts of your cousin and live together with him."

He does as he is told and invites that cousin to his mansion and they begin living together.

However, the resident couple didn't think that this would change their fate so drastically...

translation:
森林深处坐落着一座欧式宅邸。最近成为宅邸主人的年轻男人，与一名美丽女孩一起生活在那里。

两人没有血缘关系，却像兄妹一样井然有序地共同生活。然而没过多久，他们已经互相爱上了对方。

年轻男人一直遵守已故父亲临终前的遗言：“找到你的表亲，让他和你一起生活。”

他照做了，把那位表亲邀请到宅邸，两人开始共同生活。

然而，住在宅邸里的这对男女并没有想到，这会如此彻底地改变他们的命运……
